reviews.text: I got the Musk scent (the one with the light blue flower) and it smells so clean, soft, and cozy! The texture is rich thanks to the shea butter, but it absorbs surprisingly fast without leaving a greasy residue. It keeps my hands super soft and hydrated throughout the day. Perfect compact size for carrying in your purse!
reviews.zh: 我買咗麝香味（就係嗰款有淺藍色花）嘅，聞落好乾淨、柔軟、舒服！因為有乳木果油，質地豐富，但吸收快得出奇，冇油膩殘留。全日都令雙手超級柔軟、水潤。細細支好啱放喺袋入面！

reviews.text: This is definitely the best cream for my dry hands! The texture is just incredible, it reminds me of "Platyldin"—very dense and nourishing. It moisturizes perfectly, and I love this kind of effect. At the same time, the cream doesn't leave an unpleasant "oily" feeling on the skin because it absorbs completely without a trace. A real find for those who need deep hydration without any stickiness.
reviews.zh: 絕對係我乾燥雙手嘅最佳護手霜！質地真係好正，令我聯想到「Platyldin」——好厚身、好滋養。補濕效果完美，我好鍾意呢種效果。同時，面霜完全唔會留低令人唔舒服嘅「油膩」感，因為佢會完全吸收，冇任何殘留。對於需要深層補濕、唔想黏膩嘅人嚟講，係一個真正嘅好發現。

reviews.text: I want to try more scents! Although I absolutely lovee this one!! It smells so light, airy, fresh, creamy and floral!! The scent is very light, so its great for those that don't like heavy fragrance!! I love the thick, shea butter texture, it is very hydrating and nourishing...so it can be greasy, it's the best before bed or when your hands are really dry!!🎀
reviews.zh: 我想試吓更多香味！不過我真係好鍾意呢款！！聞落好輕盈、通透、清新、香滑、帶花香！！香味好淡，所以好啱唔鍾意濃烈香味嘅人！！我好鍾意呢種厚身、乳木果油質地，好補濕、滋養……所以可能會有啲油膩感，最啱瞓覺前或者雙手特別乾嗰陣用！！🎀

reviews.text: I absolutely love this hand cream! The texture is rich but absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. It makes my hands feel soft and deeply moisturized. The peach scent is so fresh and sweet — not too strong, just the perfect balance. I also like how travel-friendly the size is, easy to carry in my bag. Definitely one of my favorite hand creams for daily use! 🍑✨
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款護手霜！質地豐富但吸收快，冇油膩感。雙手摸落柔軟、深層補濕。蜜桃香味好清新同甜美，唔會太濃，啱啱好。我都好鍾意佢嘅 size 好方便外出，放喺袋入面都易攜帶。絕對係我日常用嘅最愛護手霜之一！🍑✨

reviews.text: I got the honey scented version. If you are used to the artificially scented beauty stuff we have in the west this is absolutely not that scent. This has a more fresh scent to it wih perhaps a little bit of honey. But this scent doesn't scream honey. I like how little it is and how nice the packaging looks which makes this perfect to take with you on the go. The cream soaks into my hands very quickly and is definitely more of a daytime cream since it has a very lightweight hydrating formula. If you need a very nourishing heavy duty hand cream definitely skip this one since this is just for maintenance rather than saving your hands.
reviews.zh: 我買咗蜂蜜味版本。如果你習慣咗西方嗰啲人工香味嘅美容產品，呢款絕對唔係嗰種味道。佢嘅香味比較清新，可能帶少少蜂蜜味，但唔係好大聲咁話係蜂蜜。我鍾意佢細細件，包裝又靚，外出攜帶好方便。面霜好快滲入雙手，而且因為配方好輕盈補濕，所以更加適合日間用。如果你需要好滋養嘅重型護手霜，就唔好揀呢款，因為呢款係用嚟日常保養，而唔係用嚟救手。

reviews.text: I was using this hand cream for years, but then I didn't see it in the online shops really for a long time, and I missed it. I think the formula is still the same, both Jasmine and Rose scents are the same, what more can I want. I prefer the Jasmine which is the richer formula, while my mom prefers the lighter formula with the Rose scent. Both formulas are nourishing, just to different levels.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款護手霜好多年，之後好長時間喺網店都搵唔到，我好掛住。我覺得配方應該都係一樣，茉莉同玫瑰香味都係一樣，仲可以點呀？我鍾意茉莉嗰款，因為質地比較豐富；我媽媽就鍾意玫瑰香味嗰款嘅較輕盈配方。兩款都滋養，只係程度唔同。

reviews.text: I live in a cold climate and this cream is convenient to give my hands quick hydration throughout the day. I do not have especially dry hands but this lotion helped with occasional dryness and has a fairly thick texture. The scent is pretty nice (I got the peach version) but it does have a slightly artificial scent to it that I personally do not mind.
reviews.zh: 我住喺寒冷嘅地方，呢款面霜全日都方便俾雙手快速補濕。我嘅手唔算特別乾，但呢款對偶然嘅乾燥都有幫助，質地幾厚身。香味都幾好聞（我買嘅係蜜桃味），不過有少少人工香味，我個人就唔介意。

reviews.text: I only write reviews when I think a product deserves it and as soon as I opened this tube I was in love. The scent of grape was super nice and the texture of the cream is so hydrating and not sticky at all. It's a convenient size so will even fit in your pocket and it's simple yet super cute to look at too. Will deffo be buying again when it runs out and will try other scents too.
reviews.zh: 我只會喺覺得產品值得嘅時候寫評論，而我一打開呢支管裝就已經愛上咗。葡萄味好好聞，面霜質地好補濕，完全唔黏。size 方便，甚至可以放入口袋，簡單又超級可愛。用完一定會再買，亦會試吓其他香味。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
